sentences.text:
Vinod vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 4 December, 2025
 Neutral Citation No. 2025:Mphc-Jbp:63222
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
At Jabalpur

Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Pradeep Mittal

On The 4 th Of December, 2025
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 56021 of 2025
 Vinod
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri Satyam Agrawal - Advocate for the applicant.
Shri S.M. Patel, P.L. for the State.

Order 
This is first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of BNSS/ 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.258 of 20023 registered at Police Station - Kudila District Tikamgarh (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 376(2) (n)
of the IPC and Sections 5L/6,5(i)(ii) of the POCSO Act.

The applicant has been arrested on 26.08.2025.
2.

As per the prosecution story, on 17th of September, 2023 father of hte prosecutrix has lodged a missing person report at Police Station Kudila, stating that on 13th of September, 2023 he left his home in the morning wherein the prosecutrix was in home and when he returned in the evening to his home, he could not find prosecutrix.

The father of the prosecutrix further stated that he asked his daughter-in-law for prosecutrix to which she has replied that prosecutrix at around 4 p.m. went for the nature's call after which she did not return.
After recovery of almost two years on the basis of statement of the prosecutrix, the aforesaid registered the aforesaid offence against the applicant.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:63222 2 MCRC-56021-2025 3.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.
The conclusion of the trial will take considerable time, therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant may be released on bail.
He is in custody since 26.08.2025.
There is no criminal record of the applicant.

Learned counsel further submits that prior to leaving the house, the father of the prosecutrix had forcefully got her married to some man wherein he used to physically assault her because of which she fled from there and after that she went to Delhi and there after one and half years she met the present applicant and got married to him and out of that wedlock she gave birth to a baby in the year 2024.

sentences.text: On the other hand, learned counsel for State has opposed the grant of bail to the applicant.

It is stated by the learned counsel for the State that the DNA report establishes that the applicant is the biological father of the child, therefore, the contention of the applicant appears to be wrong.
At the time of pregnancy, the victim was minor as is proved by the DNA report.

5. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case and the fact that at the time of incident the prosecutrix was a minor, the consent and married status of the victim is immaterial as she was aged about 15 years and five months at the time of occurrence of the incident,
I am not inclined to grant bail to the applicant.
Accordingly, the application for grant of bail is dismissed.

(PRADEEP MITTAL) JUDGE MSP Vinod vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 4 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/198752561/
